home.title: Every PDF tool you need. Free. Forever.
home.subtitle: No signup, no watermark, no page limits. Just pick a tool and go.

merge.label: Merge PDF
merge.description: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document, in the exact order you choose, in seconds.

split.label: Split PDF
split.description: Break a large PDF into separate single-page files, or a custom page range, downloaded as a ZIP.

remove-pages.label: Remove Pages
remove-pages.description: Delete the pages you don't need and download a cleaner, shorter version of your PDF.

extract-pages.label: Extract Pages
extract-pages.description: Pull out only the pages you need from a PDF and save them as a brand new file.

organize.label: Organize PDF
organize.description: Drag to reorder, rotate, or delete pages with a live visual preview before you save.

rotate.label: Rotate PDF
rotate.description: Fix sideways or upside-down pages by rotating your whole PDF 90, 180, or 270 degrees.

compress.label: Compress PDF
compress.description: Shrink a large PDF down to a fraction of its size while keeping text and images sharp.

ocr.label: OCR PDF
ocr.description: Run text recognition on scanned PDFs to make every page searchable, selectable, and copyable.

jpg-to-pdf.label: JPG to PDF
jpg-to-pdf.description: Combine one or more JPG or PNG images into a single, print-ready PDF document.

pdf-to-word.label: PDF to Word
pdf-to-word.description: Convert a PDF into an editable Word (.docx) file you can revise without retyping it.

pdf-to-ppt.label: PDF to PowerPoint
pdf-to-ppt.description: Turn PDF pages into an editable PowerPoint (.pptx) presentation, one slide per page.

pdf-to-excel.label: PDF to Excel
pdf-to-excel.description: Pull tables and data out of a PDF straight into an editable Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheet.

word-to-pdf.label: Word to PDF
word-to-pdf.description: Convert a Word document (.doc or .docx) into a polished, universally readable PDF.

ppt-to-pdf.label: PowerPoint to PDF
ppt-to-pdf.description: Convert a PowerPoint slideshow (.ppt or .pptx) into a PDF that looks the same everywhere.

excel-to-pdf.label: Excel to PDF
excel-to-pdf.description: Convert an Excel spreadsheet (.xls or .xlsx) into a clean, print-ready PDF document.

watermark.label: Add Watermark
watermark.description: Stamp custom text across every page of a PDF to mark it draft, confidential, or your own.

page-numbers.label: Add Page Numbers
page-numbers.description: Automatically number every page of your PDF, ready to download in one click.

edit.label: Edit PDF
edit.description: Click anywhere on a page to add text, then download a PDF with your changes built in.

crop.label: Crop PDF
crop.description: Trim the margins and white space around every page to tighten up your PDF's layout.

sign.label: Sign PDF
sign.description: Draw or upload your signature and place it anywhere on a PDF, no printing required.

protect.label: Protect PDF
protect.description: Add a password to a PDF so only the people you trust can open and read it.

unlock.label: Unlock PDF
unlock.description: Remove a password from a protected PDF once you have the right to access it.

batch.label: Batch Processing
batch.description: Run compress, rotate, watermark, and more across up to 20 files at once, free and unlimited.

privacy.label: Auto-Delete Privacy
privacy.description: Every file you upload or download is permanently deleted from our servers one hour after processing.

urdu.label: Urdu / Hindi Support
urdu.description: The full interface is available in Urdu and Hindi, not just English, for easier everyday use.

common.privacyNote: Files never leave your control. Auto-deleted 1 hour after processing

common.clickToAddText: Click anywhere on the page to add text
